title: Execution reservation
description: What execution_reserve returns: what is held for one execution and the grant the provider redeems. A paid run takes a call of a pack the consumer already bought, or buys the next pack: its price is held on the consumer's budgets and wallet and paid only when the run succeeds.

logical_intent_id.description: Links several executions of the same intended work, e.g. after failover.

plan_id.description: Plan the call is admitted under.

resource.description: What is held: budget (a pack's price, against your budgets and wallet), pack (a call of a pack already bought) or free.

funding.description: How the run is paid for: free (a free plan), purchase (it buys the plan's pack, paid if it succeeds) or pack (a call of a pack already bought).

pack_id.description: The pack whose call the run took, if any.

state.description: held (grant usable), redeemed, reconciliation_required, captured, released, expired, or unresolved (nobody proved the outcome within 30 days; nothing was paid).

grant_expires_at.description: When the grant expires: 60 seconds after reservation. Timestamp, ISO 8601 with time zone.

amount_atoms.description: What is held on your budgets and wallet: a pack's price for a purchase, 0 otherwise, in atoms (1 USD = 1000000 atoms) as a decimal string, e.g. "8000000".

commission_atoms.description: The network's commission on a purchase, kept from what the provider earns, in atoms as a decimal string, e.g. "960000".

budget_period_ids.description: Budget periods the amount is held against.

admission_id.description: Set once the provider redeemed the grant.

execution_grant.description: The grant the provider redeems before it starts the work; returned with every held reservation the requester reads.
